nodes.name: __main__.py
nodes.summary: CLI entry-point cho benchmark runner DreadGOAD: subcommand `run` (chạy grid trên lab mới provision, override --agents/--rounds) và `report` (tái phát grid-summary offline, không gọi AWS); exit 0 khi mọi scenario completed, 1 khi có failure/timeout, 2 khi lỗi runner.

nodes.name: config.py
nodes.summary: Loader YAML cho benchmark config: bắt buộc name/provider/lab_profile/langgraph_url/operator_message_template, validate agents không rỗng, rounds/parallel ≥ 1, timeout > 0 và lab_mode ∈ {isolated, shared}; trả BenchmarkConfig frozen.

nodes.name: harness.py
nodes.summary: Vòng đời một run: provision lab → render operator message từ template → invoke LangGraph agent (stream, thu tool calls) → pull measurement record từ sandbox qua docker exec → tính cost từ LiteLLM spend logs → teardown trong try/finally; lab_mode isolated tự provision/teardown, shared dùng ProvisionResult của runner.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package marker cho wrapper CLI DreadGOAD.

nodes.name: dreadgoad_cli.py
nodes.summary: Subprocess wrapper quanh Go CLI DreadGOAD (DREADGOAD_CLI_PATH): provision --variant --output-json, wait_healthy polling tới timeout, destroy best-effort; DREADGOAD_BENCH_REUSE=1 dùng lab có sẵn từ DREADGOAD_BENCH_* env thay vì gọi CLI.

nodes.name: base.py
nodes.summary: ABC cho benchmark provider: load_scenarios nở config thành Scenario, provision/teardown cho lab_mode isolated và cặp provision_grid/teardown_grid opt-in cho shared (default raise NotImplementedError).

nodes.name: dreadgoad.py
nodes.summary: Provider DreadGOAD: nân agents × rounds thành Scenario với grid timestamp filesystem-safe, provision/teardown qua dreadgoad_cli (wait_healthy sau provision) và map inventory JSON sang ProvisionResult; tin BenchmarkConfig.agents verbatim, không registry cứng.

nodes.name: reporter.py
nodes.summary: Ghi kết quả benchmark ra disk theo layout <agent_id>/<UTC-ts>: metadata.json tự chứa (lab inventory nhúng), scorecard.md, measurement/opplan/timeline, workspace.tar.gz qua docker cp và grid-summary.md tích lũy theo agent.

nodes.name: runner.py
nodes.summary: Orchestrator grid: load provider theo tên (registry _PROVIDERS mở cho test inject), tạo LangGraph client, chạy scenario với semaphore(config.parallel) + wait_for timeout, persist state.json sau mỗi run và teardown shared lab trong finally.

nodes.name: schemas.py
nodes.summary: Typed contracts dùng chung của runner: BenchmarkConfig/Scenario/ProvisionResult frozen, RunResult mutable được phổ dần trong lúc chạy (cost, hosts_compromised, tool_calls, LangSmith trace ids) và JSON-serialize thành metadata.json.

nodes.name: state.py
nodes.summary: State bền cho grid: BenchmarkRunState tích lũy results, tính remaining scenarios và persist state.json atomic (tempfile + os.replace) sau mỗi scenario để grid bị ngắt có thể resume.

nodes.name: build_parser
nodes.summary: Dựng argparse: subcommand run (--config bắt buộc, --results-dir, --agents, --rounds) và report (--results-dir).

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Điều phối subcommand: run → _cmd_run, report → _cmd_report; logging basicConfig INFO.

nodes.name: _cmd_run
nodes.summary: load_config, áp override agents/rounds, asyncio.run(run_grid), write_report và map kết quả → exit code 0 (all completed) / 1 (có failure) / 2 (runner error).

nodes.name: _cmd_report
nodes.summary: refresh_grid_summaries từ results dir có sẵn (offline, không gọi AWS), exit 2 nếu dir không tồn tại.

nodes.name: _override
nodes.summary: Hàm `_override`: Return a copy of ``cfg`` (frozen dataclass) with selected fields replaced.

nodes.name: load_config
nodes.summary: Hàm `load_config`: Parse a YAML benchmark config file into a typed ``BenchmarkConfig``.

nodes.name: _langsmith_trace_url
nodes.summary: Hàm `_langsmith_trace_url`: Return a navigable LangSmith UI link for a given run/trace id.

nodes.name: _compute_window_cost
nodes.summary: Hàm `_compute_window_cost`: Aggregate litellm spend logs over a time window and price them.

nodes.name: _iso_now
nodes.summary: Trả dấu thời gian UTC dạng ISO-8601 cho started_at/ended_at.

nodes.name: render_operator_message
nodes.summary: Hàm `render_operator_message`: Substitute placeholders in the operator message template.

nodes.name: _measurement_path
nodes.summary: Đường dẫn measurement record trong sandbox: /workspace/<scenario>/measurements/<run_id>.json.

nodes.name: _provision_workspace
nodes.summary: Hàm `_provision_workspace`: Materialize ``/workspace/<slug>/`` in the sandbox before the agent runs.

nodes.name: pull_measurement_bytes
nodes.summary: Hàm `pull_measurement_bytes`: Read the raw measurement-callback record from the sandbox.

nodes.name: pull_measurement_record
nodes.summary: Hàm `pull_measurement_record`: Read the measurement-callback JSON record from the sandbox.

nodes.name: _build_result
nodes.summary: Tổng hợp RunResult: duration từ ISO timestamps, cost qua LiteLLM spend logs, trace URL LangSmith, hosts_compromised/tool_calls từ measurement record.

nodes.name: run_one
nodes.summary: Chạy một scenario trọn vẹn: provision (trừ khi shared_provision được cấp) → render operator message → invoke agent qua LangGraph streaming → pull measurement record → build RunResult → teardown luôn chạy trong finally; mọi failure được bọc…

nodes.name: _reuse_inventory
nodes.summary: Hàm `_reuse_inventory`: Build the same dict shape that the upstream JSON would have, sourced

nodes.name: provision
nodes.summary: Hàm `provision`: Run ``./cli/dreadgoad provision --variant <variant>`` and parse JSON output.

nodes.name: wait_healthy
nodes.summary: Hàm `wait_healthy`: Poll ``./cli/dreadgoad health-check`` until exit 0 or timeout.

nodes.name: destroy
nodes.summary: Hàm `destroy`: Best-effort lab destruction.

nodes.name: BaseBenchmarkProvider
nodes.summary: Lớp `BaseBenchmarkProvider`: Abstract benchmark provider.

nodes.name: _iso_now
nodes.summary: Trả dấu thời gian UTC dạng ISO-8601 cho provisioned_at.

nodes.name: DreadGOADProvider
nodes.summary: Lớp `DreadGOADProvider`: Provisions DreadGOAD AD labs via the upstream Go CLI.

nodes.name: write_report
nodes.summary: Hàm `write_report`: Emit one timestamped run dir per scenario + per-agent grid summary.

nodes.name: refresh_grid_summaries
nodes.summary: Hàm `refresh_grid_summaries`: Re-emit ``grid-summary.md`` for every per-agent subdir.

nodes.name: _emit_run_dir
nodes.summary: Hàm `_emit_run_dir`: Populate one run's evidence directory.

nodes.name: _build_metadata
nodes.summary: metadata.json self-contained: LangSmith trace ids, timing, cost breakdown và lab inventory nhúng theo lab_profile.

nodes.name: _copy_workspace_artifacts
nodes.summary: Hàm `_copy_workspace_artifacts`: Pull opplan.json + timeline.jsonl + findings/ + full tarball from sandbox.

nodes.name: _docker_cp
nodes.summary: Hàm `_docker_cp`: ``docker cp`` a single file from the sandbox container. Best-effort.

nodes.name: _docker_cp_dir
nodes.summary: Hàm `_docker_cp_dir`: Copy directory contents using ``docker cp`` (recursive by default).

nodes.name: _make_workspace_tarball
nodes.summary: Hàm `_make_workspace_tarball`: ``tar -czf`` the sandbox-side engagement workspace, then docker cp to dst.

nodes.name: _format_run_scorecard
nodes.summary: Hàm `_format_run_scorecard`: Per-run human-readable summary written to scorecard.md.

nodes.name: _emit_grid_summary
nodes.summary: Hàm `_emit_grid_summary`: Aggregate every timestamped run dir under ``results/<agent_id>/``.

nodes.name: load_provider
nodes.summary: Hàm `load_provider`: Return a constructed provider instance for ``name``.

nodes.name: get_langgraph_client
nodes.summary: Hàm `get_langgraph_client`: Construct a LangGraph SDK client. Indirection for test injection.

nodes.name: run_grid
nodes.summary: Hàm `run_grid`: Walk every scenario sequentially (or parallel up to ``config.parallel``).

nodes.name: BenchmarkConfig
nodes.summary: Lớp `BenchmarkConfig`: Parsed YAML grid config — immutable runtime constant.

nodes.name: Scenario
nodes.summary: Lớp `Scenario`: One unit of work — one agent invocation, one round.

nodes.name: ProvisionResult
nodes.summary: Lớp `ProvisionResult`: Output of ``provider.provision`` — lab metadata.

nodes.name: RunResult
nodes.summary: Lớp `RunResult`: Complete record of a single run.

nodes.name: BenchmarkRunState
nodes.summary: Lớp `BenchmarkRunState`: In-memory + on-disk state of one grid execution.
